title: Jensen Huang Is Back, and So Is His Plaque at Denny’s
summary: The chain said it had restored a plaque honoring Mr. Huang above a booth in San Jose, Calif., after he was reinstated at Nvidia, the company he is said to have co-founded while eating there.
caption: A plaque above a booth at a Denny’s in San Jose, Calif., ties the location to Nvidia’s origin story.
